texts: ControlPlane.ai is an intelligent AI middleware designed to safely route, filter, and ground LLM queries.
The ingress stage performs PII masking, intent classification, and constraint decomposition to protect user data.
The generation stage leverages the Gemini 3.5 Flash model and applies structural formatting checks to ensure reliability.
Financial reports indicate that Q1 2024 revenue grew by 15% compared to Q3 2023, driven by enterprise AI adoption.
ControlPlane uses an asynchronous bias monitor powered by IBM AIF360 to ensure demographic and algorithmic fairness.
